# Noise test vectors (CLX-411): from haskell-cryptography/cacophony at 8ee9d41, vectors/cacophony.txt,
# and mcginty/snow at 8ac60f5, tests/vectors/snow.txt. Every Noise_*_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256
# vector in both, and cacophony's IK, XX and XXpsk3 with each of the other seven suites of 25519,
# ChaChaPoly or AESGCM, and SHA256, SHA512, BLAKE2s or BLAKE2b. All 880 25519 vectors in the two
# files pass too; these are the ones kept here.
#
# A `v` line is `v <protocol> <prologue> <initiator's static> <initiator's ephemeral> <the
# responder's static, as the initiator knows it> <responder's static> <responder's ephemeral>
# <the initiator's static, as the responder knows it> <psks, joined by commas> <handshake hash>`,
# each in hex, `-` for none. Each `m` line after it is a message, `m <payload> <ciphertext>`:
# the handshake's, each side in turn from the initiator, then transport messages, from the
# initiator for an even place in the list and from the responder for an odd one, or all from the
# initiator for a one-way pattern.
